clips.speaker: presenter
clips.name: Bella
clips.text: Today, Claude is starting a bus company in OpenTTD. Two hundred passengers, one hundred and twenty game days, and no extra borrowing.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.name: Bella
clips.text: It starts with twenty thousand. By the end, it needs at least five thousand cash and a profitable fleet. Claude makes every decision.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Bonningwell is twice the size of its neighbour, so I'll run a cross-town commuter line entirely inside it — no long road building needed.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Stops and depot are down; I'm buying two buses to start, keeping plenty of cash in reserve.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Both buses are rolling, one heading each way so the stops don't sit unserved.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Ten days in and the buses never left the garage — the depot door isn't joined to the street, so I'm fixing that.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: The buses finally made it out, and the north stop already has a crowd waiting. Let's see who gets there first.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Both stops now have big queues, so each bus should leave full from here on. The cross-town run takes about eleven days each way.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: First passengers delivered, and both buses are now driving full. I'll stick with two buses rather than spend the cash cushion on a third.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Sixty-five riders delivered and the fleet is now in profit. On this pace we should clear two hundred well before the deadline.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Deliveries came in slower than I hoped, and over a hundred people are queuing at the south stop, so I'm buying a third bus as insurance.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Cash dipped just under the safety line for now, but three full buses should earn it back before the deadline.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Two full buses are about to pull into the south stop, which should push us past the target.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.name: Larry
clips.text: Mission accomplished on day 104: 220 commuters delivered, cash above the safety line, buses in profit, and the loan never went up.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.name: Bella
clips.text: Claude met every target. 220 passengers delivered in 104 game days, with 5,627 cash left and a profitable bus fleet.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.name: Bella
clips.text: Would this company work better with two agents? We'll test collaboration in a later terrarium. Thanks for watching.
